mentions.name: Kdeps
mentions.description: This platform builds secure and private AI agents whose workflow and agency behaviours are declared in YAML and run on local LLM models. Workflows can be exported to Docker, Kubernetes, ISO, or binary with a local llamafile or gguf model pre-baked, or run locally. It also includes an agent-loop CLI for coding tasks using local LLM models as an alternative to mainstream ones, with a GitHub Action harvesting daily llamafile, gguf, and OpenRouter free models selectable via /model.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Secure and private AI agents. Declare behaviours of workflows and agencies in YAML, that uses local LLM models.

You can export the workflow to Docker, Kubernetes, ISO, or binary, with the local llamafile or gguf model pre-baked. Or just run locally.
